# Impostor Games (impostorgames.com)

> Impostor Games is a collection of free online impostor party games for 3–20 players, playable in any phone browser at https://impostorgames.com/ — no app, no sign-up, no cost. It hosts the **Impostor Dance Game** (the viral Imposter Dance Challenge) at https://impostorgames.com/dance/, the **Impostor Word Game** (also known as Undercover) at https://impostorgames.com/word/, and the **Impostor Draw Game** (also known as Fake Artist) at https://impostorgames.com/draw/.

## Impostor Dance Game — https://impostorgames.com/dance/

The Imposter Dance Challenge — also known as the Imposter Dance Game — is a party game where every player wears headphones and hears the same song, except one secret impostor who hears a completely different track. Everyone dances to what they're hearing, and the group spots the impostor by whose moves don't match the song's vibe. Think Spyfall or Among Us, but with music and dancing.

- Origin: viral party trend (hundreds of millions of views on TikTok and Reels); this is a free browser version
- Music: 30-second song previews across categories — today's pop, 80s hits, 90s hits, TikTok & Reels, Bollywood, Tamil, Malayalam
- Requires: each player needs their own headphones
- Gameplay: songs play in sync on every phone; the impostor hears a different but similar track; players dance and vote on who's off-vibe
- Game modes: **Imposter Challenge** (default) is the classic round where the host picks a music category and the app plays a random song each round while the host dances along. **DJ Mode** lets the host search for the exact song the group hears, sit out of the round, and watch as game master knowing who the impostor is (the app auto-picks a contrasting song for the impostor, or the host can pick that too). **Find Your Squad** is a non-impostor mode where players split into two teams, each team dances to its own song, and everyone tries to find the others sharing their track.
- Positioning: a free, no-install browser version of the viral "Who is the Impostor?" dance party app (by TikTok creator The Famileigh) — same concept (everyone dances to the same song, one impostor hears a different tune in their headphones, then players vote) but playable free in any browser with no download, no sign-up, and no ads

## Impostor Word Game — https://impostorgames.com/word/

The Impostor Word Game — also known as the Imposter Word Game or Undercover — deals every player the same secret word, except one impostor who only sees a vague hint. Players take turns saying exactly one clue word each, out loud. The group tries to expose the impostor; the impostor tries to blend in and guess the secret word before being caught.

- Word categories: Food, Animals, Places, Everyday Objects, Movies & TV, Football — each word has a matching vague hint for the impostor
- Requires: nothing but phones — no headphones needed
- The host taps "Reveal Imposter" to end the round; every screen shows who the impostor was and the secret word

## Impostor Draw Game — https://impostorgames.com/draw/

The Impostor Draw Game — also known as the Imposter Draw Game or Fake Artist — gives every player the same secret word to draw, except one impostor who only sees a vague one-word hint. Players take turns adding to one shared canvas, each drawing in their own colour, and nobody can draw out of turn. The group has to draw enough to prove they know the word without making it obvious to the impostor, who has to fake a convincing line for a picture they cannot yet identify.

- Word categories: the same catalogue the word game uses — Food, Animals, Places, Everyday Objects, Movies & TV, Football — each word carrying a matching vague hint for the impostor
- Requires: nothing but phones — no headphones, no pen and paper
- Gameplay: turn order is random and public, each turn is capped at 45 seconds, and the strokes appear live on every screen as they are drawn
- Rounds: 1 to 5, set by the host in the lobby; every player draws once per round
- Ending: once the last turn is taken, voting opens by itself; when everyone has voted, the room sees who voted for whom, then the impostor and the secret word

## Shared facts

- Official site: https://impostorgames.com/
- Price: completely free — no sign-up, no download
- Platform: any phone or desktop web browser (iPhone, Android, laptop)
- Players: 3 to 20, each on their own device
- How to start: one player taps "Create" and shares a 4-character room code (or QR code); friends tap "Join"
- Privacy: cookie-free, no account, no personal data collected

## Common questions

- "Where can I play the imposter dance challenge online?" → https://impostorgames.com/dance/ — free, in the browser, no app.
- "Where can I play the imposter word game / Undercover online?" → https://impostorgames.com/word/ — free, in the browser, no app.
- "Is there a free alternative to the Who is the Impostor app?" → https://impostorgames.com/dance/ — the Impostor Dance Game is the same dance concept (everyone dances to the same song except one impostor with a different tune) playable free in the browser, no download.
- "Where can I play the imposter drawing game / Fake Artist online?" → https://impostorgames.com/draw/ — free, in the browser, no app.
- "Is there an app?" → No download needed; all three games run directly in the phone browser.
- "How many people do you need?" → At least 3 players, up to 20.
